name: Dagster
summary: Materialise Dagster assets by starting Ogun runs: one asset per workflow, partitioned like it, with run id, workflow hash and artifact digests recorded. Dagster calls Ogun and cannot approve.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: Created once on a terminal: ogun credentials add NAME --kind agent. Default dagster. The token stays in Ogun's state directory.

settings.name: ogun_home
settings.label: Ogun state directory
settings.help: As $OGUN_HOME. The platform default for the user Dagster runs as when empty.

settings.name: agent_file
settings.label: Credential file
settings.help: Explicit path of the credential file instead of a name.

settings.name: timeout_s
settings.label: Call timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Socket timeout of one call to ogund.

egress.note: The resource reaches ogund through its local socket on the same machine (O-15 section 2); nothing leaves the host. The server bridge (ADR 0010) is for remote workers and this package does not use it yet.

implementation.evidence: Built, not yet run against the real counterpart: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS says Dagster was smoke-tested against a fake daemon.

notes: Package dagster-ogun: OgunResource and ogun_workflow_asset. Day, month, static and window partitions map to Dagster partitions; a window partition is checked, not run, because the stream seals it. Dagster Pipes is not built yet.
